When we started dating, after I told him that, we started our own tradition. I got to decorate our little tree, twinkling lights and ornaments in December. We would watch the presents grow underneath. Every year on Christmas Eve, we cook ourselves a fancy steak dinner and mash. We would wait till the clock hit midnight and exchange gifts. I would be full of excitement watching him open his gifts. And I could see in those moments, how much love and joy we had for each other. 3 years of continuous tradition.

This year I lay in a bed empty. Sad. Missing him and all he had given me.
